verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in, first-party MCP server at /mcp. Agents connect over HTTP (e.g., `claude mcp add --transport http glitchtip .../mcp`), and its documented tools cover browsing issues, inspecting stack traces, updating issue status, searching logs, and detecting N+1 queries. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and documented authentication/permission details for agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: GlitchTip includes a built-in MCP server that allows AI assistants to interact with your error tracking, performance, and log data.
claude mcp add --transport http glitchtip https://your-glitchtip.example.com/mcp
Investigate errors — Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
GlitchTip has a built-in MCP server so you can pull your own error data into your preferred AI tools with no data sharing required.
